# Release tools that CI downloads as pinned release files and checks against a hash before it
# runs them (ADR 0020, decision 5). scripts/install-release-tool.sh reads this file.
#
# Columns: tool, version, file name, sha256, download URL. Separated by spaces.
# To bump a tool: download the new files over HTTPS, compare each hash with the .sha256 file the
# project publishes next to it, put the hashes here, and run scripts/test-install-release-tool.sh.
# The hashes were taken from the project's own release page, so the first trust is in that page.
# After that, a changed file fails the check.
#
# cargo-auditable is not here. The release workflow installs it with a SHA-pinned
# taiki-e/install-action at an exact version, which checks its own hashes.
